submit_package_to_pypi: run the submit script to build and upload a Python package to the default PyPI repository
submit_package_to_custom_repository: run the submit script with --repository flag to upload a package to a custom PyPI repository
submit_package_with_gpg_signing: run the submit script with --identity flag to GPG sign files before uploading to PyPI
submit_package_with_authentication: run the submit script with --username and --password flags to authenticate with the PyPI repository
submit_binary_distribution: run the submit script with --bdist flag to build and upload a binary wheel distribution instead of sdist
